description: Per-agent, per-cycle budget snapshot. Derived from chain events with cost / agent_id / cycle_id fields — re-computable, not authoritative. The single invariant: balance increases ONLY via external settlement credit. Internal activity only spends. When balance < cost-of-next-append, the agent yields until an external grade arrives.

cycle_id.description: Identifier of the cycle this state belongs to.

agent_id.description: REQUIRED. The agent whose budget this is. Per-agent budgets only — no shared pools (inter-agent transfer of credit is forbidden by construction). Maps to chain event.agent_id.

opening.description: Balance at cycle-open. Carried from prior cycle's `closing` minus decay. For an agent's first-ever cycle, opening = seed_budget configured at chain layer.

spent.description: Sum of cost across all chain events this agent appended in this cycle. cost = base + k * size(event).

credit.description: Sum of credit earned from settlement events this cycle. credit > 0 only when outcome = PASS from external_grader. FAIL or NO_VERDICT yield 0. Credit is the only way balance can increase.

balance.description: Current available balance. Computed: balance = opening - spent + credit. Can briefly go negative during settlement reconciliation; sustained negative means the agent over-generated past depletion.

closing.description: Finalized balance at cycle-close. null while cycle is open. Computed: closing = opening - spent + credit. Carries forward (with decay) to next cycle's opening.

decay_delta.description: How much closing balance decays before becoming next cycle's opening. Configured per-cycle. An agent that never spends and never ships falls behind because saved balance erodes — prevents hoarding.

ships_count.description: Telemetry. Number of shipped artifacts this cycle (chain events with content_kind in {pr, doc, registration, ...} that referenced this agent).

external_outcome.description: Telemetry. Settlement outcome for this cycle (once settled). null while cycle is open.

per_channel.description: OPTIONAL multi-channel breakdown. When omitted, all cost is implicitly the 'compute' (token) channel and the scalar opening/spent/credit/balance/closing fields are authoritative. When present, keys are channel names (`compute`, `energy`, `attention`, `correction_tax`, `ratchet`, …) and values are per-channel {opening, spent, credit, balance, closing}. Invariant: sum-across-channels(spent) = scalar spent, same for opening / credit / balance / closing. Each channel settles independently — energy credits via kWh + grid-mix, attention credits via human-bounded response-latency budget, ratchet credits via durable-capability-added.

depleted_at.description: Wall-clock when balance first crossed below cost-of-next-append (yield threshold). null while solvent. Past this point the agent must yield until external grade credits the balance.

agent_state.description: Where the agent is in its cycle. `active` = currently spending and below depletion threshold. `yielding` = below cost-of-next-append, paused. `depleted` = balance <= 0, must wait for credit. `awaiting_grade` = work shipped + external grader contacted, not yet returned. `settled` = cycle closed (closing populated).

cycle_state.description: The cycle's terminal/in-flight status. `OPEN` = events still being appended. `GRADING` = settlement event in flight, external grader contacted. `CLOSED` = settlement.outcome captured terminal verdict. `ABORTED` = cycle closed without settlement (operator interrupt, system shutdown). `CANCELED` = pre-empted before any spending.

derived_from_shas.description: Cause-effect lineage. sha_seals of events that caused this budget-state event beyond the immediate prev_sha chain. Multi-input causation: a budget-state derived from N chain events references all N (or the boundary shas of the window). Enables O(graph) lineage-impact queries — 'what's downstream of this' and 'what's upstream of that conclusion' become first-class operations.

last_event_sha.description: sha_seal of the most-recent chain event rolled into this state. Enables incremental rollup.

event_count.description: Number of chain events rolled into spent. Audit aid — re-rollup should produce the same `spent` for the same count.

recorded_by.description: Agent that recorded this state event.
